main.description: Who may reply to a hidden post, and which replies its author hides for everyone. Written by the post's author in the post's space, at the post's record key. Enforced where posts are shown.

post.description: The gated post: the author's own tools.umbrae.post at this record's key, in this space.

allow.description: Absent: anyone who can see the post may reply. Empty: nobody.

hiddenReplies.description: Replies, in this space, hidden for everyone but their authors.

followingRule.description: Accounts the author follows, publicly or hidden.

followerRule.description: Approved members of the author's followers space.

list.description: The record key of one of the author's personal tools.umbrae.list records.
